acip: DE NYID NGO BO JI LTA BU ZHE NA, (SGRIB MED) STE SGRIB PA DANG BRAL BA'I (LHAN SKYES) KYI (DGA' BA'I) NGO BOR GYUR PA'I YE SHES KYI RNAM PAR (ROL BA DANG) NGO BO (DBYER MED) PA'I CHOS KYI DBYINGS STONG PA NYID DE,
wylie: de nyid ngo bo ji lta bu zhe na, (sgrib med) ste sgrib pa dang bral ba'i (lhan skyes) kyi (dga' ba'i) ngo bor gyur pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par (rol ba dang) ngo bo (dbyer med) pa'i chos kyi dbyings stong pa nyid de
english: "And just what is Their essence?" you may ask.  They are emptiness itself, the Realm of Is, indivisible in Their essence from the divine play of the wisdom whose own essence is that bliss which is simultaneous, free of every obstruction--released from every obstruction there is.
